# grouper_folder (Resource)

Manages a Grouper folder. The parent folder must already exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grouper_folder" "apps" {
  name              = "org:dept:apps"
  display_extension = "Applications"
  description       = "Groups that control access to applications"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full name of the folder, with segments separated by colons, such as `org:dept:apps`. Changing the last segment renames the folder, and changing its parent replaces it, since Grouper can't move folders.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the folder.
- `display_extension` (String) Display name of the folder itself, shown in the Grouper UI. Defaults to the last segment of `name`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the folder.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Folders are imported by full name
tofu import grouper_folder.apps org:dept:apps
```
